objective: Test whether the proposed |x|<theta activation gate exposes a nontrivial lossy sparsity Pareto on the four expensive bottleneck Conv inputs, using frozen H67 ep35, PAFT ep4, paired control ep4 and train-only traces before any RTL or A800 accuracy job.

mechanism.scope: four bottleneck Conv input sources only

decision_rule.go: At least one nonzero theta in the frozen grid must drop a nonzero but not all nonzero sources on at least one operator and cohort.
decision_rule.fastkill: If every operator is exactly {0,a_l} with every tested theta <= min_l(a_l), the grid exposes zero incremental sparsity; if theta>a_l transitions directly to dropping all active sources, G7 has an empirical precision cliff and no useful measured intermediate point.

red_lines: Do not generalize the four bottleneck Conv result to FC, patch embed or attention without their traces.
Do not infer accuracy from activation codebooks.
